heading: INT. LUNAR DOME GREENHOUSE - STATION NIGHT

units.text: INT. LUNAR DOME GREENHOUSE - STATION NIGHT
A glass cathedral of mist.
Rows of dwarf wheat under pale blue lights.
Beyond the dome's curve, a black sky and a blue Earth, small and unconcerned.

CAPTAIN ZARA ODUYA-LINDQVIST (50s, close-cropped silver hair, a station jacket worn through at the elbows) stands at a central console, one hand flat on the glass, watching a tiny green number tick down.
Her engineer, BARNABY TREMAINE-OKORO (40s, bearded, a spanner in his belt), wrestles with an access panel.
At a bench, a young botanist, SOLOMON ADEBAYO-KRAUSE (20s, wire-rimmed glasses, a tablet in each hand), sorts seed trays.
Eleven minutes.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: It's eleven minutes to what?
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: To the air scrubbers failing.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: Is that what the alarm was?
units.name: SOLOMON

units.text: That is what the alarm is.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: Barnaby pulls the panel loose.
It clangs on the deck.
Blue sparks spit from the wiring beneath.
I can bypass it.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: How long?
units.name: ZARA

units.text: Four minutes.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Do it in three.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: Captain, I can do it faster.
units.name: SOLOMON

units.text: Don't touch it, kid.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Zara and Solomon both turn.
Barnaby's hands are already inside the panel.
I know what I'm doing.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Solomon, the seeds.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: What about them?
units.name: SOLOMON

units.text: They go in the airlock. If the scrubbers die, they go with us.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: With us, where?
units.name: SOLOMON

units.text: Anywhere.
units.name: ZARA

units.text: Solomon scoops the trays into his arms.
The dome lights flicker.
A siren whoops, then falls silent.
The three of them hold perfectly still, listening to the long hush of the failing air.
Then a door at the dome's edge clicks open.
A WOMAN in a gray station suit and a respirator steps through, a canister in each hand.
She is breathing hard.
I found the leak. Where is the captain?
units.name: WOMAN

units.text: Zara raises a hand.
The Woman drops both canisters on the console with a ringing clang, and wrenches off her mask.
Underneath: Zara's own face, twenty years younger.
